records.statement: For nonnegative a2,a3,a4 with m'=a2+a3+a4>=1 and M=2a2+3a3+4a4>=10, and integer 0<=k<=M with 3k>=M, put g_r=(2r/(2r+1))*binom(M-r,k-1)/binom(M,k), using integer-zero-extended binomials. Then g2-2g3+g4>=0. Hence E=sum_r a_r g_r is at least (3m'-M)g2+(M-2m')g3 for 2m'<=M<=3m', and at least (4m'-M)g3+(M-3m')g4 for 3m'<=M<=4m'.

records.statement: For every finite index set I, any function r:I->Nat (zero sizes allowed), and every natural k, let H(X)=product_{i in I}((1+X)^(r_i)+X) in Polynomial Nat. Then coeff(H,k)=sum_{S subseteq I} if |S|<=k then Nat.choose(sum_{i in I\S}r_i,k-|S|) else 0. The subtraction occurs only in the guarded branch; Nat.choose is zero above its upper argument.

records.statement: Let I be a finite family of positive disjoint block sizes r_i>=1, M=sum_i r_i, and F_i(X)=sum_{t=0}^{r_i} f_i(t)X^t with real coefficients f_i(t)>=binom(r_i,t). Put H=product_i F_i, choose a uniform k-subset of the M labeled elements for 0<=k<=M, and let K_i be its block counts. With w_i(t)=f_i(t)/binom(r_i,t)>=1, H[k]/binom(M,k)=E product_i w_i(K_i). Moreover H[k]>=binom(M,k) exp(y_k)>=binom(M,k) E_d(y_k) for each natural d, where y_k=sum_i sum_{t=0}^{r_i} [binom(r_i,t)binom(M-r_i,k-t)/binom(M,k)]*2(f_i(t)-binom(r_i,t))/(f_i(t)+binom(r_i,t)), using integer-zero-extended binomials.
